svg.title: Mockup 10: First run, sign-in and the shell
svg.text: 10 · First run, sign-in and the shell
The first run in three steps ends on the control center; sign-in shows the event’s poster, or the platform’s when no event is known; the shell’s header and menu hold still.
Use case: the person who installed the platform makes the event; organisers and crew sign in from any device (1280 px and 390 px)

g.text: Organisers and crew sign in here.
Admin opens at the venue or on the crew network.

svg.text: A · 1280 px: sign-in with the event’s poster

g.text: Organisers and crew sign in here.
No event is open at this address yet.

svg.text: B · 390 px: no event resolves, so the platform’s poster
C · The header holds one line
DE
Demo Event
Live
Badge, name and state on one
centre line, at every width.
The menu stays put
Scrolled to the page’s foot:
Profile and Sign out stay.

g.text: Whoever installed the platform has it.
Three groups of four, letters and digits.
It changes on every restart until used.
Sign in: you become the owner
Owners give organiser and crew roles.
Sign in now; the account you use
Pick the first and last day

svg.text: D · first run at 390 px: code, sign in, basics; the same steps centred on a desk
Notes
The first run asks only what the event cannot open without;
venue, look and access wait on Event basics (E6).
After the last step the owner lands on the control center,
with an empty run of show and “Set up the run of show”.
The menu puts the two homes first, then the parts that are on,
then the event’s own pages (L7). Parts switched off leave it.
With no event at this address, sign-in shows the platform’s
poster instead of an empty one.
